identity.title: [v0.92][runtime] Operationalize distributed Runtime and polis Observatory across Wuji and AWS

values.review_scope: Production distributed Runtime launcher, Guardian/kernel authority wiring, single polis Observatory API/WSS, serial Wuji and AWS orchestration, security, failure/recovery, teardown, evidence, and operator-gated publication.
review_prompts: Do real Guardian and kernel processes form one authenticated polis rather than independent singleton runtimes?
Is there exactly one coherent redacted Observatory per polis, with no hidden per-node authority split?
Can Phase B start under any Phase A residue or unproven cleanup state?
Are API/WSS, partition, fencing, migration, recovery, and shutdown exercised through production paths?
Is AWS use private, ephemeral, correct-account, and fully torn down?
Are exact argv, evidence, and reviewer provenance independently verifiable?
